description: Automatic package updates (story E01-004). Updates wait seven days after release, the same rule as uv and pnpm.

packageRules.description: Minor and patch updates merge themselves when every check passes.
Major updates wait for a review.
GitHub Actions updates are grouped into one pull request.
A uv update can change _virtualenv.py, whose hash is in tools/startup-files-allowed.txt, so the uv program and the uv image are reviewed before they are merged.
dependency-cruiser cannot read TypeScript 7.0, so the client stays on TypeScript 6 until 7.1.
Container images are pinned by digest. The tag is kept next to the digest so that people can see the version.
Chromium for the browser tests comes from Playwright's image, which has to match the version of @playwright/test, so the two are updated together.
Updates to source code built in the Dockerfiles are reviewed before they are merged, because the version is also written in the build flags of the same stage, and Renovate does not update those.

Registries other than Docker Hub give Renovate no release dates, so these images are not held back by the seven-day rule. mcr.microsoft.com/playwright waits for @playwright/test, because the two versions have to match.
The Tailscale image and the Tailscale source built in the same Dockerfile are updated together, and reviewed.
The Caddy images and the Caddy version built with xcaddy are updated together, and reviewed.
The cosign that the installer downloads is checked against a hash, which a person updates.

customManagers.description: Versions marked with a renovate comment in pyproject.toml and the workflows: uv, and the Grype and Syft versions of the scan and SBOM actions.
Images named in Python scripts, marked with a renovate comment and named by digest, as in the Dockerfiles.
Images named in the workflows, marked with a renovate comment.
Source code cloned in the Dockerfiles: the release tag and the commit it is checked against.
The Caddy version built with xcaddy, which has to match the Caddy images in the same Dockerfile.
Programs downloaded by the installer, marked with a renovate comment. Their hashes are updated by a person, so until then the update fails the cosign check in the Container bundle job.
